Why we moved to vanilla JS

March 5, 2026

After years of relying on heavy frameworks, our team decided to strip everything back to the basics. We found that the overhead of managing dependencies was outweighing the benefits of the abstractions provided.

By using native Web APIs, we achieved significantly faster load times and a much smaller bundle size, making the experience seamless for users on low-bandwidth connections.
